[IARC.8.6] **No wire / protocol surface.** libds has
no protobuf wire codec, no peer abstraction and no
per-role peer specializations (adapter / storage /
debug / sibling tier). Its interaction with anything
outside its own process is entirely via typed C callbacks
the integrator registers. If integrators want bytes,
they do the encoding themselves on whatever wire
fits their stack. See [IARC.1.14] and [IARC.2.3].
